skills.skill_desc:
When Dyrroth's Rage reaches 50%, he enhances <font color="a6aafb">Burst Strike</font> and <font color="a6aafb">Spectre Step</font>.

After every 2 Basic Attacks, Dyrroth releases a Circle Strike, dealing<font color="fba51f"> (+150% Total Physical Attack)</font>-<font color="fba51f"> (+180% Total Physical Attack)</font> (scales with level) <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in the circle (enhanced damage does not apply to turrets), and recovering <font color="26e407">7%</font>-<font color="26e407">10%</font> <font color="26e407"><1005></font> (scales with level, halved against minions or turrets). This strike does not trigger Attack Effect.
Each time he damages an enemy, the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Burst Strike</font> and <font color="a6aafb">Spectre Step</font> is reduced by 1s.

Dyrroth recovers 2% - 5% Rage per second (scales with level).

Dyrroth releases a burst strike in a designated direction. Each burst deals 240<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies and slows them by 25% for 1.5s. (The damage decays against the same target and decreases to only 75% on minions.)

<font color="a6aafb">Abyss Enhanced</font>: Burst Strike has a longer range, deals 140% of the original damage, and its Slowing Effect is doubled.

Dyrroth dashes in the target direction. He stops upon reaching the max distance or hitting an enemy hero or creep, dealing 230<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and slightly knocking them back.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Dyrroth locks onto a target and unleashes a Fatal Strike, dealing 345<font color="fba51f"> (+120% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and reducing their <font color="fba51f"><1060></font> by 40% for 4s.

<font color="a6aafb">Abyss Enhanced</font>: Fatal Strike reaches further and deals 150% of the original damage, slows the target by an extra 90%, and reduces their <font color="fba51f"><1060></font> by 60% for 4s.

After a short delay, Dyrroth launches a destructive strike in the target direction, dealing 650<font color="fba51f"> (+250% Extra Physical Attack)</font> (+ 25% of the target's <font color="26e407">lost <1997></font>) as <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in its path, and slowing them by 55% for 0.8s.
This skill can only be interrupted by <font color="a6aafb">Suppression</font>.
Damage dealt to non-hero enemies is capped at 1500.
